summary: First-iteration full backend + frontend E2E testing of Consenso Plus (multi-tenant AI BOS SaaS). 23/23 backend pytest tests pass including the slow AI pipeline endpoints (/api/inbound/simulate and /api/agents/{id}/test). Frontend login, all 9 sidebar nav routes, inbox 3-pane layout, inbound simulator (auto-creates lead), agents page RUN FULL PIPELINE (returns intent/structure/decision/reply JSON) and logout all work correctly. Tenant isolation verified.

minor.issue: LLM provider occasionally returns generic fallback text ('I'm having trouble reaching the AI service...') on first call — app handles this gracefully but intent also falls back to 'other/general/medium/0.5'. Acknowledged in problem statement as acceptable.

design_issues.screen: Inbox header — conversation detail top right
issues: The 'Welcome back' toast briefly overlaps the 'TAKE OVER / CLOSE' action buttons in the top-right when first loading the inbox; minor, auto-dismisses.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: tune LLM router fallback so when provider is cold, a second retry is attempted server-side before emitting the fallback message, so intent analysis panel doesn't show 'other/general/50%' on the very first simulated message.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~540 lines — still manageable but consider splitting into routers/{auth,conversations,agents,leads,tickets,integrations,team,admin}.py as the product grows past 700 lines.

`/api/admin/tenants` returns the current tenant for non-platform_admin/owner roles as a 'read-only self view'. The role check `role != 'platform_admin' and role != 'owner'` is inverted-ish — owners get full access to ALL tenants' data (see `tenants = await db.tenants.find({})`), which is a cross-tenant leak if there were multiple real tenants registered. Should restrict full list to `platform_admin` only.
Integration PUT accepts only whitelisted keys (good). But agent.tools is a dict list without validation — consider Pydantic validation for shape.
Passwords in /api/team/invite require min length? No validation on password length — consider enforcing >=8 chars.
Mongo queries use {"_id": 0} projection consistently — good, prevents ObjectId serialisation bugs.
seed_data_creation: Seed already ran on startup (demo tenant Acme Corp with 3 conversations, 1 lead, 1 ticket, 9 integrations, 1 agent 'Aria — Default AI'). Tests also exercised /api/auth/register which correctly creates tenant + owner + default agent + webchat integration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all endpoints. Run via: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. AI pipeline tests are marked @pytest.mark.slow and may take 10-30s each. Frontend selectors use data-testid heavily: login-email/login-password/login-submit, nav-{inbox,agents,leads,tickets,integrations,analytics,team,admin,settings}, sim-{name,channel,text}, btn-simulate, btn-test-agent, btn-takeover, btn-close, btn-logout, agent-{name,tone,goal,model,system-prompt,rules,knowledge,test-input}, convo-item-{uuid}, lead-{uuid}. Integrations nav is labeled 'Channels' in UI but routes to /app/integrations. Note: The 'LOG IN →' button text has a trailing arrow, so use data-testid='login-submit' not text match.
rca of the issue: One test (test_register_new_tenant) initially failed because the fake email used `.test` TLD which Pydantic's email-validator rejects as reserved. Fixed by using `@example.com`. Not a backend bug — purely a test-side issue.
